## Context

User wants to emulate the terminal setup from DevOps Toolbox's YouTube video (Omer Hamerman). They want everything except Nushell. The current stack: Ghostty + Zsh (Oh My Zsh, robbyrussell theme, oh-my-posh kali prompt) + Nushell (oh-my-posh) + Nvim (kickstart-based, custom "burns" colorscheme) + tmux.

Already installed: JetBrains Mono Nerd Font, tmux, Oh My Zsh with plugins.
Not installed: Starship, Atuin, Zellij.
Already done: Ghostty Catppuccin Mocha theme applied.

**Scope:** Replace nvim burns theme with Catppuccin Mocha. Install and configure Starship, Atuin, Zellij. Set Ghostty font. Preserve existing dotfiles structure and Oh My Zsh setup.

**Anti-scope:** Do NOT touch Nushell config. Do NOT install Hammerspoon, Karabiner, SketchyBar, Nix-darwin.

### Starship Prompt
